item.title: Film posters for The Mummy banned from public display in UK
item.summary: Watchdogs say adverts in London tube stations broke its rules with ‘realistic impression of a dead child’ W arning: graphic image Film posters for The Mummy have been banned from outdoor public display in the UK because they include realistic depictions of a dead child. The UK’s Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) received 30 complaints over the promotional campaign in London tube stations for the new Lee Cronin film. Continue reading...
